blind.description: A stylized architectural wall segment featuring an open rectangular doorway. It is constructed from warm yellowish-tan daub or plaster over a dark brown timber frame, featuring a thick wooden capping beam across the top, timber jambs and lintel framing the opening, and timber plinth blocks at the base. Several small recessed exposed wooden patches break through the plaster surface near the frame. All surfaces are clean, solid, and hand-painted in a stylized fantasy game style, standing flat directly on the ground without an extra base.
blind.from_above: A single narrow, horizontal rectangular dark brown wooden beam stretching across the top.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 ft tall (the doorway opening is roughly the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, with the wall and top beam extending higher) and roughly 5 ft wide.
